title: Hadronic vacuum polarization: lattice versus data-driven tension
bottleneck: The Fermilab muon g-2 experiment's final 2025 result agrees with Standard Model predictions that use lattice QCD for the hadronic vacuum polarization, but the traditional data-driven determination from electron-positron annihilation data disagrees with the lattice value at several sigma. Both methods claim maturity, yet they cannot both be right.
why_it_blocks: The hadronic vacuum polarization dominates the theory uncertainty in the muon's magnetic moment; until the two methods agree, the most precise test of the Standard Model rests on a disputed calculation.
current_state: The 2025 final Fermilab measurement at 127 parts per billion matches the lattice-based prediction within about one sigma, but the collaboration notes the lattice versus data-driven tension must be clarified for a firm comparison.
